subject: science
description: Self-paced Grade 9 Physics lesson on harmful effects of EM radiation, aligned to MATATAG Quarter 1 Force, Motion, and Energy.
learningObjectives: Explain why higher-energy EM waves can harm living cells
Describe harmful effects of UV, X-rays, and gamma rays
Identify protective actions such as sunscreen and shielding
Interpret risk as depending on energy, intensity, and exposure time
prerequisites: Simple circuit and wave ideas from earlier grades
